missing: Measured, not calculated, runtimes on real 1,000 Wh-class units (Jackery Explorer 1000 v2, EcoFlow DELTA 2, Anker SOLIX C1000, Bluetti AC180) with a 1,500 W heater on high: which inverters actually hold 1,500 W continuously without tripping or throttling, what the actual minutes were, and current prices for the ones that pass.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears at all. Three niche sites (testedwatts, homepowerfacts, lightsonlab) answer the question with the same spreadsheet math (~30–35 minutes), and all admit or imply no lab testing; eight of the twelve results had no readable text. A page that puts a 1,500 W heater on actual 1,000 Wh units, reports measured runtime and inverter behaviour, and names which models to buy at current prices would stand out against calculated estimates.
